units.source_text: 雨是围住了罗生门，从远处沥沥的打将过来。

en.t: The rain surrounded Rashomon, drizzling in from far away.

units.source_text: 黄昏使天空低下了；仰面一望，

en.t: Dusk made the sky seem low; when one looked up,

units.source_text: 门顶在斜出的飞甍上，支住了昏沉的云物。

en.t: the top of the gate, above its slanting projecting eaves, seemed to hold up the dark, heavy clouds.
